subject: Brightline pilot: stakeholder agenda, milestones & commitments
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@brightline.health>, Dr. Aaron Park <aaron.park@brightline.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Brightline pilot: stakeholder agenda, milestones & commitments

Hi Sophie / Aaron —

Thanks for your time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed mutual action plan so we’re aligned on owners and timing. I pulled the items we discussed into three priority buckets:

1) Goals & success criteria
- Reduce average inference latency for triage workflows from ~420ms to <150ms (p95)
- Maintain HIPAA-safe handling with customer-managed keys
- Pilot must show 30% unit-cost reduction vs. current hosted baseline

2) Top pain points called out
- Varying latency spikes during batch ingestion windows
- Ops team needs clearer audit logs and token-level cost breakdowns
- Procurement needs an implementation timeline and security artifacts for review

3) Proposed Mutual Action Plan (timeline + owners)
- Week of Jan 19: Technical kickoff (Redwood owner: Marissa Cole) — run small integration test with representative payloads; deliver initial latency profile by Jan 26. (Attachment: Brightline_MAP_v1.xlsx)
- Week of Feb 2: Security review & KMS integration (Redwood owner: Mina Haddad) — provide SOC2 section, data flow diagram, and KMS guidance by Feb 5.
- Week of Feb 9: Procurement & pricing review (Redwood owner: Aditya Rao) — finalize pilot subscription, T&Cs, and deliver purchase-ready quote by Feb 12.
- Week of Feb 16: Pilot go/no-go decision with execs (Brightline owners: Sophie Lane + Dr. Aaron Park) — aim for pilot start Feb 23 if approved.

Immediate asks from your side:
- Sophie: confirm primary pilot dataset and point person for sample payloads (name + contact)
- Aaron: are there any additional compliance artifacts beyond SOC2 and KMS we should prepare now?
- Procurement: please confirm timeline expectations for contract review (procurement@brightline.health)

I attached a short MAP workbook with the milestones above and a one-pager on pilot packaging. I’ll follow up internally with Aditya and Marissa to lock owners. Please reply with any edits to owners/dates and I’ll update the tracker.

Thanks,
Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Brightline_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet - MAP), redwood-pilot-pricing-onepager.pdf (PDF)
From: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@brightline.health>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dr. Aaron Park <aaron.park@brightline.health>, procurement@brightline.health
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Brightline pilot: stakeholder agenda, milestones & commitments

Thanks Mina — great write-up. Couple quick clarifications:

- Primary dataset: clinical triage transcripts; point person is Maya Singh (maya.singh@brightline.health) — she can share a small, de-identified sample by Friday Jan 16.
- Compliance: we will need a diagram for data residency (EU customers routing) in addition to SOC2 and KMS details.
- Procurement timeline: we typically run a 2-week review for pilots once we have the quote and SOW; procurement@brightline.health will start the review week of Feb 2.

As for owners/dates, the proposed MAP looks reasonable. We’d like the technical kickoff Jan 20 instead of Jan 19 if possible (internal calendar constraint). Otherwise good to go.

Thanks Mina — I updated the MAP with estimated effort and added line-items for the pilot SKU. Attached is a one-pager with pilot pricing and what’s included (support hours, dedicated rollback plan, and optional burst capacity).

Quick notes for Brightline:
- Estimated pilot cost (4-week): $18,000 — includes reserved throughput for 2 GPUs and up to 250k tokens/day.
- Optional add-on: private KMS integration setup fee $3,500 (one-time).
- Standard pilot SOW and terms are attached; procurement, if you can review week of Feb 2 we’ll be ready to route signature via DocuSign the same week.

Sophie / procurement: I’ll open a HubSpot deal record and attach these docs; let me know if you need a redline window (we can offer a 2-business-day turnaround on standard non-critical changes).
